win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined line on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 1. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol required to win.

specials.name: LUCKY SEVEN SYMBOLS
specials.behavior:
The Max Win Machine will only reveal Lucky Seven and dead symbols. A win is created when 1, 2 or 3 Lucky Seven symbols land in a line. A win needs to start at the left-most reel. 

 When a win occurs, the value awarded from the combination will be multiplied by the current bet to determine the win.

 1 Lucky Seven symbol awards 1x 
 2 Lucky Seven symbols award 10x 
 3 Lucky Seven symbols award {maximumWinMultiplier}x 

 Dead symbols are non-paying symbols and have no other effect.
